item.title: Despite her objection | Netanyahu trial judges order attorney general to attend
item.description: The judges in Prime Minister Netanyahu's trial rejected the attorney general's request not to attend a hearing on the continued conduct of the trial and ordered her to appear this coming Wednesday.

item.title: Supreme Court rules Rabbi Haim Amsalem's conversions acceptable for Law of Return
item.description:
The Supreme Court unanimously rejected an appeal by the Population and Immigration Authority, ruling that conversions conducted by the private Orthodox rabbinical court "Ahavat HaGer," headed by Rabbi Haim Amsalem, must be recognized for the purpose of obtaining immigrant status.
The justices determined that the rabbinical court is a serious institution that carefully examines the sincerity of conversion candidates.
